# Vendored JavaScript

Checked in rather than pulled from a CDN or npm: the app ships no build step and
makes no third-party requests at runtime.

| file | package | version |
|------|---------|---------|
| `htmx.min.js` | [htmx.org](https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.7/dist/htmx.min.js) | 2.0.7 |
| `sse.js` | [htmx-ext-sse](https://unpkg.com/htmx-ext-sse@2.2.4/sse.js) | 2.2.4 |

To upgrade, download the new version over the file and bump the table.
